description: This file defines the 'GrainDirectoryPartition' class, which manages a partition of the distributed grain directory in Orleans. It handles membership snapshots, range locking, snapshot transfer, activation recovery, and integration with cluster membership changes. The class includes methods for acquiring and releasing range locks, processing membership updates, snapshot transfer, and integrity checking.

classes.name: GrainDirectoryPartition
classes.description: Represents a single contiguous partition of the distributed grain directory, managing membership, range locks, snapshot transfers, and consistency checks within the Orleans runtime.

classes.name: PartitionSnapshotState
classes.description: Stores state pertaining to a snapshot of a partition, including its version, associated grain addresses, and transfer partners.

methods.name: CreateGrainId
methods.description: Creates a grain ID for the partition based on silo address and partition index.

methods.name: RefreshViewAsync
methods.description: Refreshes the current membership view asynchronously to include updates up to a specified version.

methods.name: GetSnapshotAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a snapshot of the directory partition for a specified range and version.

methods.name: AcknowledgeSnapshotTransferAsync
methods.description: Acknowledges receipt of a snapshot transfer from a silo for a specific range and version.

methods.name: ProcessMembershipUpdate
methods.description: Processes an update to the cluster membership, updating internal state accordingly.

methods.name: ReleaseRangeAsync
methods.description: Releases ownership of a range, removes addresses, and records transfer partners.

methods.name: AcquireRangeAsync
methods.description: Acquires ownership of a range, transfers entries, and possibly recovers missing data.

methods.name: TransferSnapshotAsync
methods.description: Transfers a snapshot of entries from a previous owner silo for a specific range.

methods.name: RecoverPartitionRange
methods.description: Recovers data for a range that has changed ownership or experienced failure.
